displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E2.1
meaning: Retry exceeded: flame was never sensed. One-hour lockout after 3 times.
causes: Flame never sensed during the ignition trials
diySteps: Write the code down. Open the Active Alarm or Last 6 Faults (L6F) menu only if you already know that control; otherwise leave the door on
The same guide's heating sequence says the ignitor warm-up is about 20 seconds and flame must be sensed within 4 seconds
Technician: find why flame was never sensed. Typical flame current in this guide is 0.75 to 3.0 microamps, read as DC volts on the FP pads (1 VDC = 1 microamp)
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if E2.1 returns. The one-hour lockout is the control stopping further tries, not a repair.
